Alex W.: heading out in ~30m, doing overnight handoff. I'm primary until 23:45 PDT, Mira will be secondary. Jordan, I know you have a red-eye — confirm your offline window. There's already some noisy paging from `model-latency-p99` in eu-west-1; I'm proposing a temporary threshold bump during the window to reduce non-P1 churn. Sam has been pinged for approval. Also FYI: INC-412 is active (started ~5m ago), some customers seeing slower embeddings and occasional 5xxs. I'll post exact steps for the threshold change and runbook pointers in thread. Please ack.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-412 | severity: P1 (degraded) | services: hosted-api-embeddings | region: eu-west-1 | ts: 1923456795. Pager dispatched to primary oncall.

Jordan T.: I can stay primary until 00:20 PT, then I'll be offline for boarding + flight (00:30-03:00 PT). If Alex needs to step out, Mira can take primary for that window? I won't be reachable on phone during flight but can check DM once landed.

Mira K.: I can flip to primary 00:30-03:00 PT if Alex remains reachable for any P1 escalations. I will silence non-P1 tokens and only page for P1/P0. Confirming: Alex, you want to bump `model-latency-p99` from 280ms -> 450ms for 00:00-04:00 PT (eu-west-1) and create a PagerDuty suppression rule for lower severities?

Alex W.: yes, that's the plan. Sam approved the temporary change. Customer-impact note: embeddings are slower but not failing for most; a minority of requests get 5xx — those are being throttled by an overloaded shard. We don't want alert fatigue while we triage shard rotation. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/latency-noise

Mira K.: also adding the quick `oncall` CLI command if anyone needs to roll back or reapply thresholds without console:

```
# bump p99 threshold for eu-west-1 for a window
oncall alert-modify --alert model-latency-p99 --region eu-west-1 --threshold 450 --start "2026-03-14T00:00:00Z" --end "2026-03-14T04:00:00Z" --reason "overnight noise suppression (approved)"
```

Mira K.: after applying, run `oncall alert-status --alert model-latency-p99 --region eu-west-1` and verify the active threshold. If anything looks off, ping me or Sam.

Sam L.: confirming I approved the threshold bump and suppression for non-P1 pages for the 00:00-04:00 PT window. :thumbsup: Alex, please document the PD suppression ID when you create it.

Ravi P.: quick caution — suppressing non-P1 pages will reduce noise but could mask regressions affecting small-traffic workloads. Please attach a cust_tag to logs for any 5xx spikes during the window so we can backfill telemetry and run retro if needed. Also enable the lightweight eval job for the embeddings cohort `cohort-1000` so we get quality regression signals overnight.

Alex W.: noted. I'll add `cust_tag=overnight-suppression-1923456789` to the suppression metadata and trigger the eval job now. Creating PD suppression and will paste ID here.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: INC-412 | note: triage in progress, rotating overloaded shard, mitigation attempt #1 applied (retry-backoff added). ts: 1923456800.

Alex W.: PD suppression created: sup-7723 (applies to non-P1 alerts for model-latency-p99 in eu-west-1 for 2026-03-14T00:00:00Z->2026-03-14T04:00:00Z). Added tag `overnight-suppression-1923456789`. Dashboard link: https://internal.redwood/dashboards/embeddings-eu-west-1

Jordan T.: acked — thanks for covering Mira. I'll DM if I need a quick hand before takeoff.

Mira K.: I'll be primary 00:30-03:00 PT and will escalate to Alex or Sam for anything that looks like full outage. I'll follow runbook steps: rotate shard -> increase retry window -> monitor rolling restarts. If we need a rollback of the threshold bump, run the inverse command or remove suppression.

Alex W.: adding my Slack status (Oncall/Leaving) and phone number in DMs for faster reach. Leaving the thread in monitored mode. Good handoff everyone. :raised_hands:

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: INC-412 | severity: P1 (degraded) | current assignee: Alex W. | comments: suppression sup-7723 active; eval job triggered; continue monitoring. ts: 1923456805.

Mira K.: got it. will report any P1s immediately.
